buzzRounds.topic: Kucherov asks Tampa Bay for a trade
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Nikita Kucherov, the Tampa Bay Lightning's all-time leading scorer, has told the team he won't re-sign and asked for a trade. On Monday he said money isn't the issue and cited "poor communication and respect." General manager Julien BriseBois said the Lightning "unequivocally have no intention of trading Nikita."
buzzRounds.whyCare: Kucherov, 33, won the Hart Trophy as the league's most valuable player in 2019 and 2026, has two Stanley Cups, and has 1,142 points for Tampa Bay. He can become a free agent after this season, and he has 18 points in 13 games for a Lightning team at 8-3-2.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Kucherov, a two-time league MVP with 1,142 points for Tampa Bay, just asked for a trade, and the Lightning say they won't trade him.

Ottawa Senators.storyline: Ottawa led 3-0 in the first period and then gave up six straight goals, four on the power play; it was only the second time in Ducks history they won by three or more goals after trailing by three or more.
Ottawa Senators.bringUp: The Senators blew a 3-0 lead and lost 6-3 in Anaheim on Sunday, though Drake Batherson stretched his point streak to eight games, meaning he has a goal or assist in eight straight.

details.name: Drake Batherson
details.buzz: Batherson extended his point streak to eight games with an assist in the loss at Anaheim.

details.name: Jonas Johansson
details.buzz: Johansson made 27 saves but allowed six goals as Anaheim's Cutter Gauthier scored a hat trick (three goals by one player).

Philadelphia Flyers.latestResult: Won 6-3 against the Utah Mammoth at home (now 4-8-4)
Philadelphia Flyers.storyline: The Flyers entered with the league's lowest scoring average at 1.93 goals per game, then scored a season-high six to snap a three-game losing streak as Travis Konecny returned from a 10-game absence.
Philadelphia Flyers.bringUp: Matvei Michkov scored again in the Flyers' 6-3 win over Utah on Sunday, giving him 10 goals in 16 games, only the fifth Flyer in the past 20 seasons to hit 10 that fast.

details.name: Matvei Michkov
details.buzz: Michkov has 10 goals in 16 games, carrying a Flyers team that has struggled to score.

details.name: Travis Konecny
details.buzz: Konecny had a goal and an assist in his first game back after missing 10 games with a lower-body injury.

Pittsburgh Penguins.storyline: Sidney Crosby passed Ray Bourque for the most assists by a player with one team, 1,113, and tied Marcel Dionne for sixth on the all-time points list at 1,771, but Pittsburgh lost on a Josh Anderson goal that deflected in off Kris Letang.
Pittsburgh Penguins.bringUp: Sidney Crosby now has 1,113 assists, the most anyone has ever had with one team, and Erik Karlsson also had a goal and two assists in Saturday's 5-4 loss in Montreal.

details.name: Sidney Crosby
details.buzz: Crosby passed Ray Bourque's 1,111 assists with Boston for the one-team record and tied Marcel Dionne at 1,771 career points.

details.name: Erik Karlsson
details.buzz: Karlsson's three points gave him 952 for his career, passing Brent Burns for 10th among defensemen in league history.

San Jose Sharks.latestResult: Lost 2-1 against the Calgary Flames at home (now 7-8-1)
San Jose Sharks.storyline: San Jose has lost four of its past five games, and Monday's only Sharks goal came from rookie defenseman Sam Dickinson, his second career goal, exactly one year after his first.
San Jose Sharks.bringUp: The Sharks lost 2-1 to Calgary on Monday for their fourth loss in five games; Yaroslav Askarov made 20 saves and Sam Dickinson scored the lone goal.

details.name: Sam Dickinson
details.buzz: Dickinson's third-period goal was the second of his career; his first came on November 2, 2025, against Detroit.

details.name: Yaroslav Askarov
details.buzz: Askarov allowed two goals on 22 shots, but San Jose managed only one goal against Calgary's Dustin Wolf.

Seattle Kraken.storyline: Seattle had beaten Calgary 6-1 twice earlier this season but lost 6-2 in Calgary, where Philipp Grubauer was pulled after allowing four goals on 14 shots and coach Lane Lambert called the last two periods the worst 40 minutes since he arrived.
Seattle Kraken.bringUp: Berkly Catton has a point (a goal or assist) in six straight games, a career-best streak, but the Kraken lost 6-2 in Calgary on Friday after beating the Flames 6-1 twice earlier this season.

details.name: Berkly Catton
details.buzz: Catton extended his career-long point streak to six games, with two goals and five assists in that stretch.

details.name: Philipp Grubauer
details.buzz: Grubauer was pulled midway through the second period after allowing four goals; Joey Daccord finished the game.

St. Louis Blues.latestResult: Won 5-4 at the Detroit Red Wings (now 7-6-1)
St. Louis Blues.storyline: The Blues scored three times in the third period to rally, and Aleksanteri Kaskimaki's first NHL goal, in his 11th game, was the winner.
St. Louis Blues.bringUp: Aleksanteri Kaskimaki's first NHL goal won it for the Blues, 5-4 in Detroit on Saturday, after Justin Barron tied it in the third period.

details.name: Aleksanteri Kaskimaki
details.buzz: Kaskimaki is the second Blues player in 10 years whose first NHL goal was a game-winner, after Jake Neighbours in 2021.

details.name: Justin Barron
details.buzz: Barron tied the game 4-4 midway through the third period before Kaskimaki's winner.

Tampa Bay Lightning.latestResult: Lost 5-4 in a shootout at the Nashville Predators (now 8-3-2)
Tampa Bay Lightning.storyline: Sportsnet's Elliotte Friedman reported that Nikita Kucherov, the reigning most valuable player (Hart Trophy winner), told Tampa Bay he won't re-sign and wants a trade; general manager Julien BriseBois said the team has no intention of trading him, and Vasilevskiy made 29 saves in the shootout loss that followed.
Tampa Bay Lightning.bringUp: Nikita Kucherov had three assists in a shootout loss in Nashville on Saturday, a day after Sportsnet reported he asked for a trade; the Lightning say they won't move him.

details.name: Nikita Kucherov

lastGame.label: at Nashville Predators, lost 5-4 in a shootout

details.buzz: Kucherov set up Tampa Bay's first three goals in Nashville; he is in the final season of an eight-year, $76 million contract.

details.name: Andrei Vasilevskiy

lastGame.label: at Nashville Predators, lost 5-4 in a shootout

details.buzz: Vasilevskiy made 29 saves, but former Lightning captain Steven Stamkos won it for Nashville in the shootout (a one-on-one shooting contest after overtime).

Toronto Maple Leafs.storyline: Auston Matthews has a point (a goal or an assist) in all eight of Toronto's road games this season, 15 points in all, and scored his 11th goal as the go-ahead marker in Vancouver.
Toronto Maple Leafs.bringUp: Auston Matthews scored his 11th goal in the Leafs' 4-2 win in Vancouver on Halloween, and he has a point in every road game this season; William Nylander added a goal and an assist.

details.name: Auston Matthews
details.buzz: Matthews' go-ahead goal extended his season-opening road point streak to eight games, with seven goals and eight assists.

details.name: William Nylander
details.buzz: Nylander opened the scoring 1:23 into the game, his 10th goal of the season.

Utah Mammoth.storyline: Utah gave up six goals to a Flyers team that came in averaging a league-low 1.93 per game, though Mikhail Sergachev stretched his point streak to seven games.
Utah Mammoth.bringUp: Logan Cooley scored again in Utah's 6-3 loss in Philadelphia on Sunday and has five goals in his last three games, and Mikhail Sergachev has a point (a goal or assist) in seven straight games.

details.name: Logan Cooley
details.buzz: Cooley has six points (five goals, one assist) during a three-game point streak, including a power-play goal in Philadelphia.

details.name: Mikhail Sergachev
details.buzz: Sergachev has eight points (three goals, five assists) during a seven-game point streak.

Vancouver Canucks.latestResult: Lost 4-2 against the Toronto Maple Leafs at home (now 3-12-1)
Vancouver Canucks.storyline: Vancouver is 1-11-1 in its past 13 games, leaving it with 3 wins in 16 games this season.
Vancouver Canucks.bringUp: The Canucks are 3-12-1 after a 4-2 home loss to Toronto on Halloween; Brock Boeser scored on the power play and Leevi Merilainen made 24 saves.

details.name: Brock Boeser
details.buzz: Boeser scored his fifth goal, a power-play breakaway that tied the game 1-1, and credited Filip Hronek's pass.

details.name: Leevi Merilainen
details.buzz: Merilainen made 24 saves, including a stop on Toronto rookie Gavin McKenna's backdoor chance.

Vegas Golden Knights.latestResult: Lost 3-2 in a shootout at the Boston Bruins (now 9-5-2)
Vegas Golden Knights.storyline: Vegas rallied from 2-0 down on goals by Mark Stone and Trevor Connelly to force a shootout (a one-on-one shooting contest after overtime) before David Pastrnak scored the only shootout goal, leaving the Golden Knights 1-3-2 in their past six games.
Vegas Golden Knights.bringUp: Mitch Marner had two assists in Boston on Monday and has a point (a goal or assist) in 10 straight games, but Vegas lost 3-2 in a shootout and is 1-3-2 in its last six.

details.name: Mitch Marner

lastGame.label: at Boston Bruins, lost 3-2 in a shootout

details.buzz: Marner's two assists stretched his point streak to 10 games, with one goal and 13 assists in that span.

details.name: Mark Stone

lastGame.label: at Boston Bruins, lost 3-2 in a shootout

details.buzz: Stone's power-play goal was his 10th of the season and started the Vegas comeback.

Washington Capitals.latestResult: Lost 5-1 against the Minnesota Wild at home (now 8-5-0)
Washington Capitals.storyline: Minnesota's Kirill Kaprizov reached 500 career points against Washington in his 413th game, tying Evgeni Malkin as the fourth-fastest active player to get there; Alex Ovechkin, one of the three ahead of him, did it in 373 games.
Washington Capitals.bringUp: The Capitals lost 5-1 at home to Minnesota on Sunday despite 24 saves from Logan Thompson, and Kirill Kaprizov got his 500th point against them, a mark Alex Ovechkin reached in 373 games.

details.name: Alex Ovechkin
details.buzz: Ovechkin was held without a point; a Cole Hutson shot deflected off his skate at the post, but Washington couldn't convert the loose puck.

details.name: Logan Thompson
details.buzz: Thompson made 24 saves in the loss as Minnesota pulled away.

Winnipeg Jets.storyline: Winnipeg has lost nine straight games (0-7-2), and goalie Stuart Skinner was pulled after allowing five goals for the second straight start; the Jets traded Connor Hellebuyck to New Jersey on October 23.
Winnipeg Jets.bringUp: The Jets have lost nine in a row after a 7-0 loss in Carolina on Sunday; Stuart Skinner was pulled after five goals on 17 shots and Mark Scheifele had four shots but no points.

details.name: Stuart Skinner
details.buzz: Skinner was pulled at 9:09 of the second period, the second straight start in which he gave up five goals.

details.name: Mark Scheifele
details.buzz: Scheifele had four shots but no points as Carolina goalie Pyotr Kochetkov won his 10th straight game to open the season.
